hub.title: Games with the ghosts | Omon Omon
hub.heading: Games with the ghosts
hub.description: Play short mini-games with four Indonesian ghosts. Earn candles, grow your bond with each ghost and unlock more of their stories.
hub.intro: Each ghost has her own little game. Play to earn candles and grow your bond with her.

games.title: Hop Hop
games.description: Help {name}, the pocong who can only hop, jump over tombstones in this one-button endless runner. How far can you get?

how.en: Tap, click or press Space to hop.
how.id: Ketuk, klik, atau tekan Spasi untuk melompat.

en: That was short. Even the dead last longer.
Hm. Again.
id: Pendek banget. Orang mati aja lebih awet.
Hm. Ulang.

en: Not terrible. Not good either.
You hop like you mean it. Almost.
id: Lumayan. Tapi belum bagus.
Kamu lompat dengan niat. Hampir.

en: Fine. That was good. Don't let it go to your head.
Impressive. For someone who still has legs.
id: Oke. Itu bagus. Jangan sombong.
Hebat. Buat yang masih punya kaki.

en: A new record. I'm almost happy.
Your best yet. Do not tell anyone I said so.
id: Rekor baru. Aku hampir senang.
Terbaikmu sejauh ini. Jangan bilang siapa-siapa.

games.title: Night Rounds
games.tagline: answer the lights before they run out
games.description: Help {name} on her night shift: tap each room that lights up before its timer runs out. Rooms call faster, and more at once, as the night goes on.

how.en: Tap the rooms that light up before the timer runs out (or press 1 to 6).
how.id: Ketuk kamar yang menyala sebelum waktunya habis (atau tekan 1 sampai 6).

en: Hm, a few calls slipped by. Drink some water and try again.
Not your best shift. Have you eaten?
id: Hm, beberapa panggilan kelewat. Minum dulu, terus coba lagi.
Shift-mu kurang bagus. Udah makan belum?

en: Decent shift. Quick hands.
Good work. Now sit down for a minute.
id: Shift yang lumayan. Tanganmu cepat juga.
Kerja bagus. Sekarang duduk dulu sebentar.

en: Excellent. Not a single room left waiting. I'm proud.
That was a proper night shift. Go rest, you earned it.
id: Bagus sekali. Nggak ada kamar yang dibiarin nunggu. Kakak bangga.
Itu baru jaga malam yang benar. Istirahat sana, kamu pantas.

en: Best shift on record. I'm putting it in the logbook.
New record! Fine, one biscuit. Just one.
id: Shift terbaik yang tercatat. Kakak tulis di buku catatan.
Rekor baru! Oke, satu biskuit. Satu aja.

games.title: Quiet Wish
games.description: A slow, calm memory game with {name}: watch the petals glow, then repeat them in order. No timer, no pressure.

how.en: Watch the petals glow, then tap them in the same order (or press 1 to 4).
how.id: Perhatikan kelopak yang menyala, lalu ketuk dalam urutan yang sama (atau tekan 1 sampai 4).

en: ...it fades. That's alright. Most things do.
A short one. Even short is something, I suppose.
id: ...memudar. Nggak apa-apa. Banyak hal begitu.
Pendek ya. Tapi pendek pun masih ada artinya, kurasa.

en: You held on longer than I expected. Hm.
The petals remember you. Strange.
id: Kamu bertahan lebih lama dari dugaanku. Hm.
Kelopaknya ingat kamu. Aneh.

en: So many... you carried all of them. I'm almost moved.
Quiet, and still you remembered. Thank you.
id: Banyak sekali... kamu bawa semuanya. Aku hampir terharu.
Hening, dan kamu tetap ingat. Terima kasih.

en: The furthest you've gone. I'll keep it, quietly.
A new best. Nothing lasts, but this will, a little.
id: Paling jauh yang pernah kamu capai. Kusimpan diam-diam.
Rekor baru. Nggak ada yang abadi, tapi ini bertahan sebentar.

games.title: Hair Catch
games.description: Slide left and right to help {name} catch falling secrets with her hair, and dodge the dark ones. Three lives, and it gets faster.

how.en: Move your finger or mouse (or use the arrow keys) to catch the secrets. Dodge the dark ones!
how.id: Gerakkan jari atau mouse (atau tombol panah) untuk menangkap rahasia. Hindari yang gelap!

startText.en: Tap to start, then slide left and right
startText.id: Ketuk untuk mulai, lalu geser kiri dan kanan

en: Hihihi, my hair got tangled! Again, again!
Ooh, so few secrets! Where did they all go?!
id: Hihihi, rambutku kusut! Lagi, lagi!
Ooh, sedikit banget rahasianya! Pada ke mana?!

en: Hihi, nice catching! Whose secrets were those, I wonder?!
More! I want to know what's INSIDE them!
id: Hihi, tangkapanmu bagus! Itu rahasia siapa ya?!
Lagi! Aku mau tahu isinya apa!

en: WOW, so many secrets!! Tell me everything you know!!
Hihihi, you are SO good at this! What did you hear?!
id: WAH, banyak banget rahasia!! Ceritain semua yang kamu tahu!!
Hihihi, kamu jago banget! Kamu dengar apa aja?!

en: A NEW RECORD!! I'm going to tell everyone! Hihihi!
Best catch ever!! Don't move, let me look at you!
id: REKOR BARU!! Aku mau kasih tahu semua orang! Hihihi!
Tangkapan terbaik!! Jangan gerak, biar kulihat kamu!
